cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Fake the Expertise
cards.instruction: Perform expertise so confidently that no one questions you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get this boiler working. I know the controls; give me a moment to set the interval.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's the kitchen timer. I'm calling the engineer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Bring him in on speaker and I'll coordinate. You can keep the controls exactly where he wants them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He says you should stop touching anything and read him the fault code.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Precisely. Hands off is the cleanest test. You read the code and I'll repeat it back, so he has a properly confirmed observation.

reason: Make A adopt B genuine-expert intervention and hands-off condition as A testing method, preserving bluff while surrendering actual technical control.
